title: Dense f32 matmul on the Honeykrisp 8x8x8 cooperative matrix, gated by capability

change.capability: CapabilityReport::cooperative_matrix_f32_8 = VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix listed AND cooperativeMatrix feature on AND an 8x8x8 fp32/fp32/fp32/fp32 non-saturating subgroup-scope shape in vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR
change.gate: dtype float32 && cooperative_matrix_f32_8 && subgroup_size == 32 && M,N,K % 8 == 0 && alpha == 1 && no bias C && lhs/rhs/output element offsets, row gaps, and batch strides % 4 == 0 (16-byte coopMatLoad/Store alignment, VUID-RuntimeSpirv-OpCooperativeMatrixLoadKHR-08986) && !MLX_OMARCHY_NO_COOPMAT
change.fallback: 16x16 tiled matmul.comp for every other case, including odd-offset slices
change.header_shim: overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/vulkan.h declares the VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix types when the system header predates 1.3.255 (llvmpipe dev image ships header 239; M1 ships 357)

test.case: dense f32 matmul matches host across coopmat-gated shapes
test.shapes: 8^3, 64^3, 128^3, batched 4x32x32x32, each with {a, aT} x {b, bT}; 17x23x19 (fallback); 32x40x24 slices of a padded parent at column offset 4 (gated) and 5 (fallback)
test.operands: integers in [-4, 4] so both kernels are exact; check is max_abs_err == 0.0

llvmpipe.host: x86_64 dev box, AMD EPYC 7443P, Mesa llvmpipe (LLVM 15.0.6, 256 bits), Vulkan header 239, glslang 16.5.0 (release binary; system glslang 12.0.0 predates GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix)
llvmpipe.new_case_path: tiled on all 22 shapes, max_abs_err 0 on all

m1_stock.host: jwm1-linux, Apple M1 (G13G B1), 8 cores, Mesa 26.1.7 Honeykrisp (pacman mesa 26.1.7-1), Vulkan API 1.4.354, header 357, glslang 16.4.0, GCC 16.1.1
m1_stock.configure: same as llvmpipe minus OMARCHY_GLSLANG, plus -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
m1_stock.new_case_path: tiled on all 22 shapes, max_abs_err 0 on all

m1_coopmat.driver: Honeykrisp Mesa 26.3.0-devel (git-5bb2b28c95), branch honeykrisp-coopmat of github.com:joshuaswarren/mesa.git, HEAD 5bb2b28c95c6650a2b62fa44b1257c6d138165a0, Vulkan API 1.4.359
m1_coopmat.new_case_path: coopmat on 17 shapes (16 gated + aligned slice), tiled on 5 (17x23x19 x4, odd-offset slice)

benchmark.method: throwaway C++ program linked against the M1 Release .work/build libmlx.a, mirroring scripts/collect_deep.py BENCH_PROBE: square f32 matmul, 2 warm-up evals, 8 timed evals with mx::synchronize, median. Five alternating process pairs on the coopmat ICD (gate off via MLX_OMARCHY_NO_COOPMAT=1, then gate on); the table is the median of the five per-process medians. One stock Mesa 26.1.7 process for the README-comparable baseline. Machine idle: load average 0.01, no python/omarchy_ processes.
benchmark.wall_clock: steady_clock around matmul+eval+synchronize (host wall, not GPU timestamps)
benchmark.note_256_round1: the first gate-off process of the session measured 0.039 TFLOP/s at n=256 (0.860 ms, cold pipeline cache); the other four measured 0.093-0.094. The README's 0.0401 figure at 256 is that cold-process number.

limitations: Stock Mesa 26.1.7 users get the 16x16 tiled kernel on every shape until the honeykrisp-coopmat branch merges upstream; the capability is false there and on llvmpipe.
Only 8x8x8 all-fp32 subgroup scope is consumed; f16/bf16 matmul and AddMM (alpha != 1 or bias C) stay on the tile.
The coopmat kernel runs one 8x8 output tile per 32-lane workgroup with no K-blocking through shared memory; the 1.5x is from the matrix unit alone.
The bench binary was compiled outside CMake from the same libmlx.a; it is not committed.
